challenge.name: Financial Portfolio
challenge.subtitle: Visualizing wealth and risk
challenge.description: Design a financial portfolio dashboard that transforms complex market data into actionable investment insights. The challenge bridges financial precision with human-centered information design.

inspirations.name: Bull and Bear Market Cycles
inspirations.description: The cyclical patterns of expansion and contraction in financial markets. These cycles influence investment strategies and risk perception.
inspirations.historical_context: The terms 'bull' and 'bear' have been used to describe market trends since the 18th century. The study of these cycles is a cornerstone of technical analysis.

key_principles.name: Cyclical Fluctuation
key_principles.description: Financial markets follow predictable, albeit irregular, patterns of growth and decline.

key_principles.name: Sentiment Amplification
key_principles.description: Market sentiment tends to amplify trends, leading to bubbles and crashes.

transferable_lessons: Visualizations should account for market cycles, not just linear growth.
Sentiment indicators can be as important as financial metrics.
design_implications: Use cyclical visualizations for market data.
Incorporate sentiment analysis into the dashboard.
